# Upstream source archives

The Xcode build reads one source archive from each corresponding directory under
`Vendor`. Archive filenames are intentionally not part of the build contract.

## Application engines

- [Ghostscript 10.07.1](https://github.com/ArtifexSoftware/ghostpdl-downloads/releases/download/gs10071/ghostscript-10.07.1.tar.gz)
- [BentoPDF Hyper Compress 1.0.0](https://codeload.github.com/alam00000/bentopdf-hyper-compress/tar.gz/9418fcfbb85852887cf449e2abee066d9f4b055a)
- [qpdf 12.3.2](https://github.com/qpdf/qpdf/releases/download/v12.3.2/qpdf-12.3.2.tar.gz)
- [qpdf libjpeg-turbo 3.1.0](https://codeload.github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/tar.gz/20ade4dea9589515a69793e447a6c6220b464535)
- [PDFium snapshot 2026.08.23](https://pdfium.googlesource.com/pdfium/+archive/162c9521f74c17bb0c8595608f23ab22cec3d407.tar.gz)
- [jpegli / JPEG XL 0.11.1](https://codeload.github.com/libjxl/libjxl/tar.gz/794a5dcf0d54f9f0b20d288a12e87afb91d20dfc)
- [jpegli libjpeg-turbo headers 2.1.5.1](https://codeload.github.com/libjpeg-turbo/libjpeg-turbo/tar.gz/8ecba3647edb6dd940463fedf38ca33a8e2a73d1)
- [Highway 1.2.0](https://codeload.github.com/google/highway/tar.gz/457c891775a7397bdb0376bb1031e6e027af1c48)
